The '''paralysis canister''' was a type of military ordnance. They were primarily used by the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]] during the [[New Republic era]] to pacify the inhabitants of an area to enable the saurian [[Ssi-ruu]]k to capture live sentient captives for [[entechment]]&mdash;an agonizing electronic process which drained the life energies of a living being into a mechanical construct like a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] or [[Swarm-class battle droid|starfighter]]. These paralysis canisters could be dropped from an altitude of 3,000 meters and could cover an area of nearly 9 square kilometers.

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mist (bounty hunter)|Mist]] carried two paralysis canisters as part of their standard ordnance loadout.<ref name="KO">''[[The Kathol Outback]]''</ref>

During the [[Bakura Incident]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ivpikkis]]' expeditionary fleet's [[D'kee-class landing ship|''D'kee''-class landing ships]] were equipped with paralysis canisters. Later, during the [[Battle of Bakura (28 ABY)|second Ssi-ruuvi invasion]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Todra Mayn]] managed to persuade [[Jagged Fel|Jag Fel]] and the other [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]/[[Bakura/Legends|Bakuran]] pilots to cooperate with the [[P'w'eck]]s by claiming that the Imperium planned to drop paralysis canisters on [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]].
